Resolves #21862

The API docs are generated from each config's JSDoc `@member` line, so a block that names a neighbouring config documents the wrong thing. This changes exactly the four lines from the issue table:

- `src/form/field/Base.mjs:51` — `isTouchedEvent_` now documented as `isTouchedEvent_='focusLeave'`
- `src/form/field/Color.mjs:33` — `colorFormatter` documented as `colorFormatter=...`
- `src/form/field/Number.mjs:56` — `excludedValues` documented as `excludedValues=null`
- `src/form/field/Range.mjs:59` — `useSpinButtons` documented as `useSpinButtons=false`

Configs, values and callers are untouched (documentation only).

**Regression guard:** `buildScripts/util/checkMemberNames.mjs` (`npm run check-member-names`) scans `src/form/field/*.mjs` and fails when a `@member` line names a different config than the one declared below its doc block. Verified locally: on the pre-fix tree it flags exactly the four lines above (exit 1); on this branch it is green (exit 0). The Playwright spec `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/checkMemberNames.spec.mjs` pins the guard's behaviour, including the four defect shapes and a real-tree scan.

Authored by @DeviousCardi (Mistral Vibe, reasoning: high, Mistral Vibe agent harness).
